subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but implementation depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus API/adapter/plugin integration, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with configuration, schema/version handling, tests, and live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Move to adapter or plugin seam
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring the Open WebUI-specific mirror behind a plugin/integration boundary, adding only any missing core API seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with configuration, schema/version handling, tests, and live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the Gateway chat/session files and is the best available routing owner for the product/storage-boundary decision.
